task: Plan a school fair. First choose the date, then choose the stalls that suit that date, then set a budget for exactly those stalls. Give one plan.

en.title: What goes wrong: side by side, but each step needs the one before
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
Three planners work at the same time, although the stalls depend on the date and the budget on the stalls.

**What it teaches**

The wrong pattern: agents side by side do not see each other's results, so the combiner joins parts that do not fit.

cs.title: Co se pokazí: vedle sebe, ale každý krok potřebuje ten předchozí
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Tři plánovači pracují současně, přestože stánky závisí na datu a rozpočet na stáncích.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Špatný vzor: agenti vedle sebe nevidí výsledky ostatních, takže slučovač spojí části, které k sobě nesedí.

teaches.en: The wrong pattern: agents side by side do not see each other's results, so the combiner joins parts that do not fit.

nodes.name: Date planner
nodes.instructions: Choose the date of the school fair and say why.

nodes.name: Stall planner
nodes.instructions: Choose the stalls for the school fair, based on the date that was chosen.

nodes.name: Budget planner
nodes.instructions: Set a budget in euros for the stalls of the school fair.
